requirements: Inspect the reuse catalogue and current source before building a capability.
Reuse established Google ownership, service connections and configuration patterns.
Configure product/project targets explicitly; never copy another product's identity, data paths or credentials as defaults.
Authentication may be shared; authorisation and data access must remain product/project scoped.
Record why existing code cannot be reused before implementing a replacement.
Keep shared modules parameterised, versioned and covered by consumer contract tests.
Preserve each product's constitution and deployment requirements.
Verify existing permissions, billing capacity and storage/runtime compatibility before provisioning or deployment.
Do not introduce another service provider or subscription as an implementation shortcut.
Keep secrets outside code, templates and task packets; use credential references.
Keep public search/AI retrieval separate from private product/customer data.
Production deployment requires separate founder approval.

web-application.baseline: Existing Human V1 Firebase connection/auth patterns plus product-owned workflows

android-application.baseline: Human V1 Kotlin/Compose/Room and Firebase integration patterns

enterprise-platform.baseline: PECP product constitution and portable provider/contract patterns
